caption: The drawing depicts a long dress with a fitted bodice and full skirt, rendered primarily in shades of beige with a pattern of small, evenly spaced darker dots. The bodice features long sleeves and a high, close-fitting collar, both of which are highlighted with dark red trim. The red trim runs along the opening edges of the bodice, forming a geometric pattern on the front and also appears at the cuffs. The skirt, attached at the waist, is full and tiered, each tier gathered and slightly ruffled, continuing the beige color and dotted pattern. To the right of the colored illustration is a black-and-white line drawing showing the back view of the same dress, portraying the general shape and ruffle details but without color or dot patterning. Both objects are set against a plain, light-colored background. A small signature appears near the bottom right of the image.
title: Dress
